clinician.final_diagnosis: pelvic venous congestion syndrome due to left ovarian vein insufficiency
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 47-year-old woman presented with diffuse lower abdomen pain, slowing of intestinal transit, and fatigue. Physical examination revealed tenderness and slight muscular defense in the left iliac region. Pelvic Doppler ultrasound showed parauterine vasculature with a dilated (approximately 7 mm), tortuous left ovarian vein consistent with venous insufficiency and pelvic venous congestion. The diagnosis of pelvic venous congestion syndrome due to left ovarian vein insufficiency was established based on the imaging findings.
